entries.topic: MONEY STORY (weekend lesson): compounding math - Rs 5,000 a month for 20 years at an assumed 12% a year = Rs 12 lakh invested, about Rs 49.5 lakh back; first 10 years build ~Rs 11.5 lakh, the last 10 add ~Rs 38 lakh (end-of-month SIP convention); no live market call, Sunday market closed, Friday close Sensex 74,459.53 (+308.49, +0.42%) and Nifty 23,053.10 (+116.35, +0.51%)
